headline: Middle East Tensions Drive Oil Prices
detail: Attacks on oil infrastructure are pushing crude prices higher. This typically acts as a drag on tech and growth sectors as it increases input costs and inflation fears.
rec: Monitor oil prices for further escalation, which could pressure your tech holdings.

headline: AI Optimism Fuels Salesforce
detail: Wall Street is watching Salesforce's AI narrative closely. While not a direct holding, this highlights the market's focus on AI, which is a key theme in your tech concentration.
rec: Stay aware of AI-related news as it impacts sentiment across the tech sector.

headline: Oracle Stock Dips Despite AI Hopes
detail: Oracle's stock fell despite AI discussions, showing that even AI-focused companies can face selling pressure. This suggests that not all AI plays are immune to market skepticism.
rec: This is a reminder that sector-wide optimism doesn't guarantee individual stock performance.
